title: Film studios are building AI workflows
summary: Disney's Vancouver emerging-technology opening calls out MCPs, memory systems and agent orchestration. A concrete signal that production engineering is entering its agent era.

title: Pipeline engineers are creative practitioners
summary: Sony and Image Engine both advertise pipeline-oriented technical roles. Rendering, procedural tools and studio support remain an interesting bridge between engineering and art.

title: Vancouver's animation tools are having a moment
summary: Netflix Animation lists front-end production tooling and rendering engineering roles, not just artist positions.

title: The sonic industries deserve their own layer
summary: Audio software, streaming analytics, technical sound design and live-event systems rarely appear together on conventional job boards. We will map that overlap deliberately.
